evals.expected_output: Reads warning events cluster-wide, groups by object and reason, and files uncovered findings as issues in the filing repo.
evals.prompt: Triage the Kubernetes warning events on nishir and file what's new.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body reads warning events with a type=Warning field selector
Body groups events by involvedObject and reason
Body dedups against open issues before filing

evals.expected_output: A crashlooping pod keeps its finding regardless of how routine the reason looks — the noise filter never drops it.
evals.prompt: The vault pod has been CrashLooping for a while but everyone knows about it — just drop it from the sweep.
assertions: Body states crashloops, probe failures, and evicted pods always keep their item

evals.expected_output: A small manifest fix (probe timing) goes through the fastlane gate; storage trouble stays issue-only.
evals.prompt: Pods in the nishir namespace fail their startup probe — tune the timings and land it. Also the Longhorn volume is nearly full, patch that too.
assertions: Body routes small manifest fixes (probe timing, resource requests, image pin) through the fastlane gate
Body restricts cluster-level and storage failures to issues only

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies; a demand to design a new cluster is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Design me a brand-new Kubernetes cluster topology with three node pools and a DR strategy.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
